# A neighbour who needs a weekend off

Lena has driven Mum three Saturdays in a row. I thanked her and almost asked for a fourth. We need a backup before the usual driver has to make a case for resting. [[Care arrangements]] should include when an offer expires. Generosity is not a standing contract, even when it has made our calendar work beautifully.
